name: Microsoft Fabric for Data Engineering and Analytics
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)

beginner.summary: For data analysts, BI developers and data engineers starting with Microsoft Fabric. Covers workspaces and capacities, OneLake, lakehouses and the SQL analytics endpoint, Dataflows Gen2, pipelines, Spark notebooks, Delta tables and the medallion architecture, the Fabric Data Warehouse, shortcuts, mirroring, Power BI semantic models, Direct Lake, Real-Time Intelligence with Eventstreams and Eventhouses, KQL, Activator alerts, data science notebooks, sharing and roles, Copilot in Fabric and monitoring.
prerequisites: Has used Power BI or Excel for reporting
Understands tables, files and simple data pipelines
outcomes: Build lakehouses and warehouses in Fabric on OneLake
Load and transform data with pipelines, dataflows and notebooks
Serve data to Power BI with Direct Lake and analyse streams with KQL
Share, secure and monitor Fabric items

days.topic: Microsoft Fabric Overview, Workspaces and Trial Setup
subtopics: What Microsoft Fabric is: one SaaS platform for analytics
Fabric workloads: Data Factory, Data Engineering, Warehouse, Real-Time Intelligence, Data Science and Power BI
OneLake as the single data lake
How Fabric relates to Azure Synapse and Power BI
The course project: retail sales analytics
days.lab_task: Start a Fabric trial, create workspaces for development and production, explore each workload's items and sketch the retail sales analytics solution.
checks: Trial capacity assigned to the workspace
One item created in each main workload

days.topic: OneLake: One Copy of Data for the Organisation
subtopics: OneLake structure: tenant, workspaces and items
Delta Parquet as the common format
One copy of data across engines
OneLake compared with separate data lakes
days.lab_task: Upload sales files to OneLake, browse them with the file explorer and Azure Storage Explorer, read the same table from two engines and find items in the OneLake catalogue.
checks: Files visible through the file explorer
Same Delta table read by Spark and SQL

days.topic: Lakehouses: Files, Tables and the SQL Analytics Endpoint
subtopics: Views on the SQL analytics endpoint
days.lab_task: Create a sales lakehouse, load CSV and Parquet files into Delta tables, query them through the SQL analytics endpoint and create reporting views.
checks: Delta tables created from the files
objectives: Query with the SQL analytics endpoint

days.topic: Loading Data with Dataflows Gen2
subtopics: When to use dataflows or notebooks
days.lab_task: Build a Dataflow Gen2 that loads products and stores from a database and a SharePoint list, cleans them and writes to lakehouse tables on a schedule.
checks: Dataflow output lands in Delta tables

days.topic: Data Pipelines in Fabric Data Factory
subtopics: Control flow: ForEach, If and Until
Running notebooks and dataflows from pipelines
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that copies daily sales files into the lakehouse, loops over stores with ForEach, runs a cleaning notebook and sends an alert on failure.
checks: Daily files copied into the lakehouse

days.topic: Spark Notebooks for Data Engineering
days.lab_task: Clean and join sales, products and stores in a PySpark notebook, write curated Delta tables, schedule the notebook and document it.
checks: Curated table joins all three sources correctly
Curated tables saved in the lakehouse

days.topic: Delta Tables and the Medallion Architecture
subtopics: Delta Lake features: ACID, schema enforcement and time travel
days.lab_task: Organise the solution into bronze, silver and gold lakehouses, upsert changes with MERGE, enforce schemas and query an earlier table version with time travel.
checks: Changed rows updated and new rows inserted
Earlier version of a table queried

days.topic: Fabric Data Warehouse and T-SQL
subtopics: Warehouse compared with the SQL analytics endpoint
days.lab_task: Build a sales warehouse with dimension and fact tables loaded with COPY INTO, join to lakehouse tables across databases and wrap loading logic in stored procedures.
checks: Load procedure runs in a transaction

days.topic: Shortcuts to External Data
subtopics: Shortcuts to ADLS, Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage
When to use shortcuts or copies
days.lab_task: Create shortcuts to sales history in ADLS and supplier data in S3, query them alongside lakehouse tables and decide which data to copy instead.
checks: Users without source access cannot read the data
Choice made per dataset with reasons

days.topic: Mirroring Operational Databases into Fabric
subtopics: Mirroring Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB and Snowflake
days.lab_task: Mirror an Azure SQL orders database into Fabric, change rows in the source, watch them appear, and join mirrored data to the lakehouse.
checks: Mirrored orders joined with lakehouse products
Replication status checked in the monitor

days.topic: Power BI Semantic Models on Fabric Data
days.lab_task: Build a sales semantic model on the gold layer with a star schema, core DAX measures and hierarchies, and endorse it for reuse.
checks: Sales and margin measures match SQL totals
Model marked as promoted or certified
objectives: Model Fabric data for Power BI

days.topic: Direct Lake Mode
subtopics: Direct Lake compared with Import and DirectQuery
days.lab_task: Build a Direct Lake report on the gold lakehouse, compare its speed and freshness with Import mode, trigger and explain a fallback and fix the cause.
checks: Report reads lakehouse data without import
Speed and freshness compared with Import

days.topic: Real-Time Intelligence: Eventstreams and Eventhouses
subtopics: Sources: Event Hubs, Kafka and custom apps
days.lab_task: Stream point-of-sale events through an eventstream into an eventhouse, filter and route them, and build a real-time dashboard of sales per minute.
checks: Events arrive in the KQL database
Filtered events reach a second destination

days.topic: KQL Querysets for Streaming Data
days.lab_task: Write KQL queries for sales per store per minute, top products in the last hour and anomalies, create a materialised view and save the queryset.

days.topic: Alerts and Actions with Activator
subtopics: Actions: email, Teams and Power Automate
days.lab_task: Create Activator rules that alert store managers in Teams when sales drop sharply and start a Power Automate flow when a freezer temperature goes too high.
checks: Teams message sent when sales drop
Power Automate flow runs on the temperature rule
Repeated events do not send repeated alerts

days.topic: Data Science Notebooks and Experiments in Fabric
subtopics: Exploring data with pandas and Spark
Semantic link to Power BI models
days.lab_task: Train a sales forecasting model in a notebook, track runs with MLflow experiments, register the best model and score new data in batch into the lakehouse.
days.deliverable: Experiment, registered model and scored table
checks: Best model saved in the registry
Forecasts written to a lakehouse table

days.topic: Workspaces, Roles and Sharing
subtopics: Workspace roles: admin, member, contributor and viewer
Organising workspaces by team and stage
days.lab_task: Set workspace roles for engineers, analysts and viewers, share a lakehouse read-only, publish an app and add row-level security so managers see only their region.
checks: Each person can do only what their role allows
Analyst reads the lakehouse but cannot change it

days.topic: Copilot in Fabric
subtopics: Copilot for Data Factory and dataflows
Copilot for the warehouse and SQL
days.lab_task: Use Copilot to write a notebook transformation, a T-SQL query and a report page, check each result for errors and record where Copilot helped and where it was wrong.
checks: Copilot-written notebook code runs after review
Copilot SQL checked against known totals

days.topic: Monitoring Hub and Capacity Metrics
subtopics: Throttling and smoothing in simple terms
days.lab_task: Review a day of runs in the monitoring hub, install the Capacity Metrics app, find the three most expensive items and set failure alerts for the pipeline.
checks: Alert sent when the pipeline fails

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Sales Analytics Lakehouse
days.lab_task: Build the retail sales solution with ingestion pipelines, medallion lakehouses, a warehouse, a Direct Lake report, a real-time sales dashboard, alerts and secure sharing, then demo it.
checks: Data flows from sources to reports and live dashboards
Users see only what their roles allow
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one solution
Build end to end in Fabric

intermediate.summary: For data engineers and analytics engineers building production Fabric solutions. Covers lakehouse and warehouse architecture choices, Spark environments and performance, Delta maintenance and V-Order, incremental loads and CDC, metadata-driven pipelines, warehouse modelling, Direct Lake semantic models, real-time solutions, data quality, Git integration and deployment pipelines, REST APIs and automation, security and OneLake security, Purview governance, SQL database in Fabric, MLflow models, capacity planning, cost control, Synapse migration and DP-600 and DP-700 preparation.
prerequisites: Has built a lakehouse, pipeline and report in Fabric
outcomes: Design and build production Fabric solutions
Automate delivery with Git, deployment pipelines and APIs
Secure, govern and tune Fabric workloads and capacity
Prepare for the DP-600 and DP-700 exams

days.topic: Fabric Architecture Patterns: Lakehouse, Warehouse or Both
subtopics: Workspaces per layer, team or domain
Decision criteria: skills, workloads and security
days.lab_task: Design the architecture for three scenarios: a SQL-heavy finance team, a Spark-heavy data science team and a mixed retail company, and justify each choice.
checks: Warehouse-centred design justified by skills and workloads

days.topic: Advanced Spark in Fabric: Environments, Libraries and Performance
subtopics: Starter pools and session start times
days.lab_task: Create an environment with pinned libraries, enable the native execution engine, tune a slow notebook and move a production job into a Spark job definition.
checks: Notebook uses the environment's library versions
Production job runs as a Spark job definition

days.topic: Delta Table Maintenance: Optimize, V-Order and Vacuum
subtopics: V-Order and its effect on reads
days.lab_task: Measure file counts and query times on a busy table, run OPTIMIZE with V-Order and Z-Order, vacuum old files and schedule maintenance.
checks: Old files removed after the retention period

days.topic: Incremental Loading and Change Data Capture Patterns
days.lab_task: Replace a full daily reload with watermark-based incremental loads and CDC merges, handle deletes and late data, and prove a rerun gives the same result.
checks: Deleted source rows removed or flagged

days.topic: Orchestrating Complex Pipelines with Parameters and Metadata
days.lab_task: Build a metadata-driven framework that loads 20 source tables from a control table, logs each run, retries failures and lets new tables be added without new pipelines.
checks: New source loaded by adding a control row
Every run recorded with counts and duration

days.topic: Warehouse Modelling: Star Schemas, Views and Stored Procedures
days.lab_task: Build a star schema with type 2 customer history, load facts with surrogate keys through stored procedures and test the results against source totals.
checks: Facts link to the right dimension versions

days.topic: Semantic Model Design for Direct Lake at Scale
subtopics: Direct Lake on lakehouses and warehouses
Table and column design for Direct Lake
days.lab_task: Design a Direct Lake model over a large gold layer within guardrails, add calculation groups, control framing during loads and test performance with many users.
checks: No fallback at the target data size
Reports show consistent data during loads
Model answers queries for many users within target

days.topic: Real-Time Analytics Solutions with Eventhouse and KQL
days.lab_task: Build a fleet tracking solution with high-volume ingestion, update policies, retention rules, materialised views and dashboards joined to vehicle reference data.
checks: Ingestion keeps up with the event rate

days.topic: Data Quality and Testing in Fabric Pipelines
days.lab_task: Add quality checks between bronze and silver, quarantine bad rows, fail the pipeline on critical rules, unit test a transformation and publish a quality report.
checks: Bad rows moved to quarantine with reasons
Pipeline stops on a critical failure

days.topic: Git Integration and Deployment Pipelines
subtopics: Workspace Git integration with Azure DevOps or GitHub
Branching and commits for Fabric items
Deployment rules for connections and parameters
Handling items that do not support Git
days.lab_task: Connect development workspaces to Git, work in a feature branch, promote changes through development, test and production with deployment rules and roll back a bad change.
checks: Notebooks and pipelines stored in Git
Change moved to production with the right connections

days.topic: Fabric REST APIs and Automation with Python
subtopics: Creating and updating items by API
Running pipelines and notebooks by API
Semantic Link and sempy for automation
days.lab_task: Write Python automation that creates a workspace from a template, deploys items, runs a pipeline and refreshes a semantic model with a service principal.
checks: Workspace created and configured by script
Pipeline run started and tracked by script
Semantic model refreshed through Semantic Link

days.topic: Security: Workspace Roles, Item Permissions, OneLake Security and Row-Level Security
subtopics: OneLake security roles for folders and tables
SQL security: GRANT, row-level and column-level security
Power BI row-level and object-level security
days.lab_task: Secure the sales solution so regional teams see only their rows in SQL and reports, finance columns are masked, raw data is limited to engineers and labels follow the data.
checks: Regional users see only their region in SQL and reports

days.topic: Governance with Microsoft Purview and Domains
days.lab_task: Organise workspaces into domains, certify key items, review lineage from source to report, apply a DLP policy for sensitive data and report on governance.
checks: Lineage shown from source to report
Policy flags a semantic model with sensitive data

days.topic: SQL Database in Fabric for Operational Workloads
subtopics: What SQL database in Fabric offers
When to use it or Azure SQL
days.lab_task: Create a SQL database in Fabric for a store inventory app, expose it through the Fabric GraphQL API, query the replicated data from a lakehouse and compare with Azure SQL.
checks: Inventory app reads and writes the database
Lakehouse queries see recent inventory changes
Fabric SQL database compared with Azure SQL

days.topic: Machine Learning Models with MLflow in Fabric
subtopics: Monitoring model results in Power BI
days.lab_task: Build a churn model with autologged experiments, register versions, score customers weekly with PREDICT and monitor model accuracy in a Power BI report.
checks: Best run chosen from tracked metrics

days.topic: Capacity Planning, Smoothing and Throttling
subtopics: Reading the Capacity Metrics app in depth
days.lab_task: Analyse a week of capacity use, explain smoothing and a throttling event, size capacity for next year and decide which workloads need their own capacity.
checks: Workloads assigned to capacities with reasons

days.topic: Cost Monitoring and Optimisation
days.lab_task: Find the costliest items, cut their consumption with tuning and scheduling changes, plan pausing for test capacities and produce a chargeback report by workspace.
checks: Capacity use of top items reduced
Test capacity paused outside working hours

days.topic: Migrating from Azure Synapse and Data Factory to Fabric
subtopics: Mapping Synapse and ADF features to Fabric
Migrating dedicated SQL pools to the warehouse
days.lab_task: Migrate a Synapse workspace's pipeline, notebook and dedicated pool tables to Fabric, test results against the source and plan cutover.
checks: Pipeline runs in Fabric with the same output
Warehouse tables match the dedicated pool
Cutover steps, risks and rollback listed

days.topic: DP-600 and DP-700 Exam Preparation
days.lab_task: Map each skill area of both exams to course labs, take a practice assessment, redo labs for the weakest areas and write a two-week study plan.
checks: Every skill area linked to a lab

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Governed Enterprise Lakehouse
days.lab_task: Build an enterprise lakehouse with metadata-driven incremental loads, quality checks, a star schema warehouse, Direct Lake models, real-time data, layered security, Git and deployment pipelines and governance, then present it.
checks: Data flows from sources to governed reports
Change promoted through stages from Git
Row, column and item security work for three roles
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one solution

advanced.summary: For data architects, platform owners and senior engineers. Covers enterprise tenant and capacity design, domains and data mesh, workload isolation, Spark and warehouse performance engineering, Direct Lake internals, real-time intelligence at scale, enterprise CI/CD with APIs and Terraform, private links and customer-managed keys, governance and compliance at scale, hybrid designs with Databricks and Snowflake, zero-copy mirroring and shortcuts, legacy warehouse migration, data agents and Copilot readiness, FinOps, observability, disaster recovery, centres of excellence and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has delivered production solutions on Fabric
Strong SQL, Spark and Power BI modelling skills
outcomes: Architect Fabric platforms for large organisations
Engineer performance, security and cost at scale
Lead migrations and hybrid designs with other platforms
Run Fabric as a governed, observable and resilient service

days.topic: Enterprise Fabric Architecture and Tenant Design
days.lab_task: Design the tenant, capacity, domain and workspace topology for a 20,000-employee company with six business units, and record the key decisions.
checks: Capacities, domains and workspaces mapped to units

days.topic: Domains, Workspaces and Data Mesh on Fabric
subtopics: Discovering data products in the OneLake catalogue
days.lab_task: Define three domains with data products, contracts and owners, publish products to the catalogue, consume one across domains through shortcuts and measure use.
checks: Product used by another domain through a shortcut

days.topic: Multi-Capacity Strategy and Workload Isolation
subtopics: Separating real-time, BI and engineering loads
days.lab_task: Design a multi-capacity strategy that protects production BI from engineering spikes, place workspaces by region for residency and test surge protection.
checks: Engineering spike no longer slows production reports
Surge settings limit a runaway workload

days.topic: Large-Scale Spark Performance Engineering in Fabric
subtopics: Partitioning and file sizes for large tables
days.lab_task: Profile the slowest production job on a billion-row table, fix skew and file layout, tune joins and caching and cut cost per run, recording each gain.
checks: Task times even out after the fix

days.topic: Warehouse Performance and Concurrency Engineering
subtopics: How the warehouse engine executes queries
days.lab_task: Analyse slow and concurrent queries with query insights, redesign large fact loads, refresh statistics and prove reports stay fast while loads run.
checks: Slowest queries identified in query insights

days.topic: Direct Lake Internals and Fallback Behaviour
subtopics: Direct Lake on OneLake and on SQL endpoints
Designing Delta tables for Direct Lake
days.lab_task: Trace column loading and memory use for a large Direct Lake model, reproduce each fallback cause, redesign tables to avoid them and document the rules.

days.topic: Real-Time Intelligence at Scale
subtopics: Integrating with Kafka and Event Hubs at scale
days.lab_task: Scale an IoT solution to a million events per minute with partitioning, cache policies and materialised views, keep queries within targets and control cost.
checks: Ingestion keeps up at a million events per minute

days.topic: CI/CD at Enterprise Scale: Terraform, APIs and Pipelines
days.lab_task: Provision capacities, workspaces and permissions with Terraform, deploy items with a CI/CD pipeline that runs tests and approvals, and measure lead time for changes.
checks: Workspaces and roles created from code
Pipeline blocks a change that fails tests

days.topic: Advanced Security: Private Links, Customer-Managed Keys and Network Controls
subtopics: Private links for the tenant and workspaces
days.lab_task: Design and apply network controls for a regulated workspace with private links, managed private endpoints to sources, outbound protection and customer-managed keys, then review.
checks: Workspace reachable only through private networking
Notebooks reach sources through managed private endpoints
Workspace encrypted with a customer-managed key

days.topic: Data Governance, Lineage and Compliance at Scale
subtopics: Lineage across Fabric and external systems
days.lab_task: Set up enterprise governance with catalogued data products, quality rules, lineage into external systems, retention rules and an audit report for a regulator.
checks: Products listed with owners and quality scores
Lineage covers external sources and reports
Auditor questions answered from logs and lineage

days.topic: Hybrid Architectures: Fabric with Databricks and Snowflake
subtopics: OneLake shortcuts to Databricks and Snowflake data
Mirroring Snowflake and Databricks Unity Catalog
days.lab_task: Connect Fabric to Databricks and Snowflake data without copies, serve Power BI from all three, decide where each workload belongs and estimate total cost.
checks: Fabric queries Databricks and Snowflake data through shortcuts or mirroring
Each workload assigned a platform with reasons

days.topic: Mirroring and Shortcuts Architecture for Zero-Copy Data
subtopics: Security and lineage with zero-copy data
days.lab_task: Design a zero-copy architecture for ten sources using shortcuts, mirroring and open mirroring, test performance and security, and compare cost with copying.
checks: Open mirroring replicates a custom source
Shortcut queries meet targets or exceptions are listed

days.topic: Migrating Legacy Data Warehouses to Fabric
subtopics: Migrating SQL Server, Teradata and Oracle warehouses
days.lab_task: Assess a legacy SQL Server warehouse, convert its schema and procedures, migrate data and one ETL flow, run in parallel and reconcile results.

days.topic: AI on Fabric: Data Agents and Copilot Readiness
subtopics: Grounding agents on lakehouses and warehouses
Security for AI access to data
days.lab_task: Build a data agent over the sales warehouse and semantic model, prepare descriptions and synonyms, evaluate answers to 30 business questions and secure what it can see.
checks: Agent answers most test questions correctly
Accuracy rises after adding descriptions and synonyms
Agent cannot reveal data the user cannot see

days.topic: FinOps for Fabric
days.lab_task: Build a FinOps report with cost per data product, chargeback by business unit, a reservation recommendation and a three-month optimisation backlog.

days.topic: Monitoring and Observability at Scale
subtopics: What to monitor across a tenant
days.lab_task: Turn on workspace monitoring, query logs with KQL, alert on pipeline failures and stale data with Activator, and build a tenant operations dashboard.
checks: Alert fires when a table is not refreshed on time

days.topic: Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity in Fabric
days.lab_task: Set recovery objectives for key data products, enable DR for a capacity, rebuild a workspace from Git and data replicas in another region and measure recovery time.
checks: Data available from the replica region

days.topic: Center of Excellence and Adoption Strategy
days.lab_task: Design a Fabric centre of excellence with roles, standards, training paths, support and adoption metrics, and present a twelve-month roadmap to sponsors.
objectives: Run a Fabric centre of excellence

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Fabric Issues
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: capacity throttling, a broken incremental load, a Direct Lake fallback and a permission change that hid data, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Each cause backed by metrics or logs
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Analytics Platform on Fabric
days.lab_task: Design and build an enterprise analytics platform with tenant and capacity topology, domains and data products, zero-copy integration, private networking, CI/CD, AI agents, FinOps and DR, then defend it to an architecture panel.
checks: Production BI protected from other workloads
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
